Rahul Gandhi's Pune Event Sees Clashes, FIR Filed Over Pellet Gun Incident

Ahead of a 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' event in Pune featuring Rahul Gandhi, clashes erupted between NSUI-Youth Congress workers and ABVP members, resulting in the booking of 6 individuals and detention of over 50 Congress workers. Separately, an FIR was filed following a protest by Rahul Gandhi regarding a student's pellet gun injury. The FIR filing was reportedly delayed, prompting Gandhi's protest and targeting of Home Minister Amit Shah. A victim stated Gandhi's support helped expedite the FIR registration. The event also saw Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis comment on the use of influencers for the event.
